objective: Maximize long-run expected GP growth, not headline ROI. Prefer high probability-weighted GP per unit time, scalable capacity, reliable execution, low player-time cost and low correlation.

shadow_learning.warning: Shadow-book outcomes measure signal behavior, not guaranteed executable fills. User-confirmed trades remain the highest-quality evidence.

capacity_model_note: Capacity is a conservative model of how much can be deployed without assuming the visible one-unit edge scales indefinitely. It is not a guaranteed fill size.
allocation_note: Exact GP allocation is intentionally not optimized when current liquid cash is unknown; the capital frontier ranks opportunities by expected GP velocity, capacity and execution quality.
